name: Lábatlan (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue and red triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Lábatlan (a blue and red shield with a white bend, a lighthouse and a building) below the name LÁBATLAN in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of blue and red triangles
